lines.t: Hi everyone, and welcome to the SpeakLab Podcast. I'm Leyla.
And I'm Sam. Today's topic is speed and thrills. Leyla, are you an adrenaline person?
Not at all. I play it safe. Even a fast lift makes me nervous.
[laugh] Then you'll love my story. Last weekend in Gabala, I did a zipline in the mountains.
Over the valley? How high is it?
High enough. When I stood at the start, I was terrified. My legs were shaking.
So why did you do it?
My friends from running club. One of them said, "I dare you." And I can never say no to a dare.
And how was it?
The first second was horrible. Then — pure thrill. I was screaming and laughing at the same time.
That's the adrenaline. My cousin Rashad loves that feeling. He rides a motorbike.
Fast?
Too fast. My aunt is always worried. At least he always wears a helmet.
And the speed limit?
[chuckle] He says he knows it. I'm not sure he follows it.
When I run, I feel a small rush too, especially at the end of a race. That's my kind of speed.
That I understand. Okay, I have a confession. Last summer I went on the big wheel on the boulevard.
The big wheel is slow, Leyla.
For me it was a big step! Next year maybe I'll take the plunge and try the zipline.
I'll hold your bag. And film everything. [laugh]
Here's your question for your next SpeakLab call: what is the most exciting thing you have ever done — and would you do it again?
Mine is the zipline. And yes — tomorrow. See you next time!
Bye for now!
